MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 100
   C. 50
   D. 11

2. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 9

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 33
   C. 14
   D. 28

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 45
   C. 36
   D. 30

14. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

16. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

17. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

20. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

21. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 5

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

23. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
